Create ONE original premium anime game story illustration atlas, exactly 1536x1024 pixels, strict 2x2 grid: four independent 768x512 landscape paintings with boundaries at x=768,y=512. No gutters, borders, captions, letters, readable writing, logos, watermarks, UI, collage overlays or extra panels. Each quadrant must have its own complete composition; keep all faces and important gestures well within its cell (at least 40 pixels from boundaries). Intended display: one quadrant at a time on a mobile story screen. Detailed expressive anime faces, rich hand-painted environmental storytelling, warm light, convincing repaired objects and hands, high production quality; never flat vector art or chibi. Reference image 1 is the game's original cover for overall art direction; reference image 2 is the six established portraits for exact character identity. Charcoal urban architecture, warm wood, restrained neon lime/cyan/violet accents. Maintain identities across every scene: Qiao Ning/乔宁 = brown ponytail young woman, lime green jacket over charcoal top; Lu Cen/陆岑 = tousled black-haired young man, cyan work overalls and light shirt; Wen Xi/闻溪 = purple-haired young woman, purple headphones; Chi Yuan/池远 = brown-haired young MAN wearing orange rain jacket; Bai He/白禾 = silver-haired grandmother with round glasses and dark floral coat; A Deng/阿灯 = small transparent lightbox ROBOT with two yellow eyes, never a human. Only include people named or implied by that scene. Show the physical action and emotional moment in the supplied story rather than four identical portraits. Any note/timetable/label is an indistinct unreadable mark; text is rendered separately by the application. Scenes below are positioned in reading order: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.
TOP LEFT: 星雪围炉夜 / 夜班暖饮铺. CAST FOR THIS CELL: only Lu Cen (陆岑, black-haired young man in cyan overalls) and Bai He (白禾, silver-haired grandmother). No extra ensemble. 暖饮铺留了一壶没有加糖的热茶，还有一锅淡淡的汤。陆岑来得晚，白禾没有重排菜单，只把他的那份重新热好。 Bai He (白禾, silver-haired grandmother): 这一杯，一直替你留着。
TOP RIGHT: 星雪围炉夜 / 星雪串灯. CAST FOR THIS CELL: only Qiao Ning (乔宁, lime jacket young woman) and Wen Xi (闻溪, purple-haired woman wearing headphones). No extra ensemble. 乔宁把纸星挂到串灯旁，颜色并不完全一样。闻溪说远远看过去，像大家各自带来的一点光，刚好照亮同一条路。 Qiao Ning (乔宁, lime jacket young woman): 不必一样亮，也能放在一起。
BOTTOM LEFT: 星雪围炉夜 / 避雪小亭. CAST FOR THIS CELL: only Lu Cen (陆岑, black-haired young man in cyan overalls) and Chi Yuan (池远, orange rain jacket young MAN). No extra ensemble. 小亭的屋檐留好排雪的位置，门边的积雪及时清掉。池远把植物往里移了一点，给来躲风的人腾出更大的空位。 Lu Cen (陆岑, black-haired young man in cyan overalls): 风大的时候，到这里坐。
BOTTOM RIGHT: 星雪围炉夜 / 六人暖桌. CAST FOR THIS CELL: only Qiao Ning (乔宁, lime jacket young woman) and Lu Cen (陆岑, black-haired young man in cyan overalls) and Wen Xi (闻溪, purple-haired woman wearing headphones) and Chi Yuan (池远, orange rain jacket young MAN) and Bai He (白禾, silver-haired grandmother) and A Deng (阿灯, transparent lightbox ROBOT). No extra ensemble. 大家把热锅放到稳固的炉座上，桌边留出不碰到衣袖的距离。阿灯不用吃饭，仍然有一只装着冬枝的碗放在它面前。 Wen Xi (闻溪, purple-haired woman wearing headphones): 现在，六个人都到齐了。

scenes: 星雪围炉夜 / 暖手小礼. CAST FOR THIS CELL: only Qiao Ning (乔宁, lime jacket young woman) and Lu Cen (陆岑, black-haired young man in cyan overalls) and Chi Yuan (池远, orange rain jacket young MAN) and Bai He (白禾, silver-haired grandmother). No extra ensemble. 乔宁和白禾做了几个布套，尺寸适合握在手心。陆岑检查好里面的暖手袋，池远把照顾方法写在礼物边上。 Qiao Ning (乔宁, lime jacket young woman): 冷的时候，记得把手暖回来。

星雪围炉夜 / 围炉小舞台. CAST FOR THIS CELL: only Qiao Ning (乔宁, lime jacket young woman) and Wen Xi (闻溪, purple-haired woman wearing headphones) and Bai He (白禾, silver-haired grandmother). No extra ensemble. 闻溪没有拿扩音器，坐在离暖炉合适的位置唱歌。白禾轻轻敲着杯沿，乔宁停下画笔，把这一首认真听完。 Wen Xi (闻溪, purple-haired woman wearing headphones): 今晚不用唱得很大声。

星雪围炉夜 / 冬夜归灯. CAST FOR THIS CELL: only Lu Cen (陆岑, black-haired young man in cyan overalls) and A Deng (阿灯, transparent lightbox ROBOT). No extra ensemble. 归灯装在回家的岔路口，光照得到地面，也不刺眼。阿灯留好低电提醒，没人需要独自看守到最后一盏灯熄灭。 Lu Cen (陆岑, black-haired young man in cyan overalls): 轮着照顾它，我们一起回去。
星雪围炉夜 / 星雪迎门. CAST FOR THIS CELL: only Bai He (白禾, silver-haired grandmother). No extra ensemble. 迎客门边挂上了一条没有名字的围巾，谁要出门就先给谁。雪地留下几串新的脚印，屋里的汤还热着。 Bai He (白禾, silver-haired grandmother): 慢慢回来，明天也有位置。
